paragraphs: OneWorldSIS sells a student information system engineered on the Microsoft Dynamics Power Platform. The system covers recruitment, admissions, student achievement, alumni engagement and financials across all stages of the student lifecycle. Microsoft Copilot, optimized by ChatGPT, is offered to bring AI into the student information system.

The solutions page lists modules for recruitment and prospective student leads, application and enrollment processing, student record management, degree and class management, and alumni management. A portal suite manages interactions including inquiry, applicant, student, faculty, parent, alumnus, donor and events online. Gradebook information is managed through interfaces to Canvas, Moodle, Desire2Learn and Microsoft Class Notebook. Financial operations and reporting are handled with Dynamics Business Central or Dynamics for Finance and Operations.

quote.text: A Student Information System built for today’s world.
